note: Every stored non-opener app reply must carry quality.judged true. A failed quality judge, including a timeout or HTTP error, fails closed with a reason and is not stored. The Dialog renderer still refuses an app turn whose quality.judged is not true.

assertions.note: A throwaway first-intake turn and a later app turn each store quality.judged true with a reply-rules producer and a model stamp. A judge HTTP failure returns no reply and a reason. The renderer still checks quality.judged.
